order: alternate accounting off/on and on/off by repetition and fixture; retain every run
exclusions: Only failed/exactness-mismatched runs, changed binary/input/configuration, wrong worker count, or independently logged reserved-core overlap; retain all excluded records and reasons. No timing-outlier exclusions.
inconclusive: Report all paired ratios/ranges. If confidence is insufficient or tails/hardware contention prevent attribution, keep accounting opt-in and do not advance to learned selection or live comparisons. No post-hoc threshold changes.
scope: Identical established plans and seeds. GPU readiness must precede timed game execution; otherwise that pair cannot qualify as a fixed-GPU comparison. Initialization is separately reported. Shared desktop GPU contention remains a limitation. These short first-milestone segments do not qualify a full adaptive controller.
statistical_rule: Report paired log-runtime ratios. Large-map aggregate point estimate must meet its gate and its one-sided 95% Student-t upper bound across the three paired pass aggregates must also meet the gate (df=2, t=2.920). Otherwise inconclusive unless the lower bound exceeds the budget. Case/tail/RSS gates remain reported as descriptive medians and full ranges with only three pairs; no post-hoc outlier removal.
startup: Write identical initial and final saves in every run. Initial save and initial checksum precede timed execution, without an optimizer readiness wait. Record ready mask at timed start; unready GPU observations remain in evidence but cannot qualify the fixed-plan GPU gate.

warm_supplement.reason: Cold startup readiness prevented fixed-GPU attribution in superseded pre-fix observations. Add reporting at the existing 1000-tick warmup boundary; no initialization waits.
warm_supplement.window: 1000 through 5000 ticks, including final required-work drain
warm_supplement.readiness: benchmark_gradient_at_start.ready_plan_mask must include Frozen8 for fixed GPU qualification
warm_supplement.gates: Same numerical gates, repetitions and confidence rule as original protocol. Evaluate warm CPU and GPU separately; retain original whole-run CPU gate and every cold-start result. Unready warm GPU pairs remain excluded from fixed-plan qualification. No threshold changes.

second_accounting_revision: Same thresholds, sample period, maps, seeds, repetitions and windows. Required before proceeding because the first accounting implementation did not qualify. Remove optional wakeups; retain all prior results separately. Do not infer causation from this comparison alone.
